title.en: Selling a car: from Quick to your first buyer
title.af: Verkoop 'n motor: van Quick tot jou eerste koper
title.zu: Ukuthengisa imoto: kusukela ku-Quick kuya kumthengi wakho wokuqala
title.xh: Ukuthengisa imoto: ukusuka kwi-Quick ukuya kumthengi wakho wokuqala
title.nso: Go rekiša koloi: go tloga go Quick go ya go moreki wa gago wa mathomo

en: Open Quick, swipe to [[Cars]] and tap [[Sell a car]]
Swipe the Quick door until it says Cars. One tap starts your advert.
af: Maak Quick oop, swiep na [[Cars]] en tik [[Sell a car]]
Swiep die Quick-deur tot dit Cars sê. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, swayipha uye ku-[[Cars]] bese uthepha [[Sell a car]]
Swayipha umnyango we-Quick uze ubone u-Cars. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, tyibilikisa uye kwi-[[Cars]] uze ucofe [[Sell a car]]
Tyibilikisa ucango lwe-Quick de lubonise u-Cars. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, šutiša go ya go [[Cars]] o kgotle [[Sell a car]]
Šutiša lebati la Quick go fihlela le re Cars. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick [[Bakkie]]
Car, bakkie, SUV or bike: pick the one you are selling. Not on the list? Tap [[Another option]].
af: Kies [[Bakkie]]
Motor, bakkie, SUV of motorfiets: kies die een wat jy verkoop. Nie op die lys nie? Tik [[Another option]].
zu: Khetha [[Bakkie]]
Imoto, i-bakkie, i-SUV noma isithuthuthu: khetha leyo oyithengisayo. Ayikho ohlwini? Thepha [[Another option]].
xh: Khetha [[Bakkie]]
Imoto, ibhakkie, i-SUV okanye isithuthuthu: khetha leyo uyithengisayo. Ayikho kuluhlu? Cofa [[Another option]].
nso: Kgetha [[Bakkie]]
Koloi, bakkie, SUV goba sethuthuthu: kgetha seo o se rekišago. Ga se gona lenaneong? Kgotla [[Another option]].

en: Pick the make
Toyota, VW, Ford, BMW, Isuzu, or type your own.
af: Kies die fabrikaat
Toyota, VW, Ford, BMW, Isuzu, of tik jou eie.
zu: Khetha uhlobo lwemoto
Toyota, VW, Ford, BMW, Isuzu, noma ubhale olwakho.
xh: Khetha uhlobo lwemoto
Toyota, VW, Ford, BMW, Isuzu, okanye ubhale olwakho.
nso: Kgetha mohuta wa koloi
Toyota, VW, Ford, BMW, Isuzu, goba o ngwale wa gago.

en: Pick roughly what year
A rough range is enough here. You type the exact year later, in the app.
af: Kies ongeveer watter jaar
'n Rowwe reeks is genoeg hier. Jy tik die presiese jaar later in die app.
zu: Khetha unyaka cishe
Ibanga elicishe lanele lapha. Unyaka oqondile uwubhala kamuva ku-app.
xh: Khetha unyaka malunga
Uluhlu olumalunga lwanele apha. Unyaka ochanekileyo uwubhala kamva kwi-app.
nso: Kgetha ngwaga ka kakanyo
Magomo a kakanyo a lekane mo. Ngwaga wa nnete o o ngwala ka morago go app.

en: Type your exact asking price
Tap [[Another option]] and type the price, for example R219 000. Buyers see exactly what you type.
af: Tik jou presiese vraprys
Tik [[Another option]] en tik die prys, byvoorbeeld R219 000. Kopers sien presies wat jy tik.
zu: Bhala intengo oyicelayo ngqo
Thepha [[Another option]] bese ubhala intengo, isibonelo R219 000. Abathengi babona ngqo lokho okubhalile.
xh: Bhala ixabiso lakho elichanekileyo
Cofa [[Another option]] uze ubhale ixabiso, umzekelo R219 000. Abathengi babona kanye oko ukubhalileyo.
nso: Ngwala theko ya gago ya nnete
Kgotla [[Another option]] o ngwale theko, mohlala R219 000. Bareki ba bona seo o se ngwadilego.

en: Tap where the car is
Pick your area. Buyers search by area.
af: Tik waar die motor is
Kies jou area. Kopers soek volgens area.
zu: Thepha lapho imoto ikhona
Khetha indawo yakho. Abathengi basesha ngendawo.
xh: Cofa apho imoto ikhoyo
Khetha indawo yakho. Abathengi bakhangela ngendawo.
nso: Kgotla moo koloi e lego gona
Kgetha lefelo la gago. Bareki ba nyaka ka lefelo.

en: Check your advert and tap [[Save my listing]]
Saving is free. Nobody sees it yet: you publish it in the app after you read the seller terms.
af: Kyk na jou advertensie en tik [[Save my listing]]
Stoor is gratis. Niemand sien dit nog nie: jy publiseer dit in die app nadat jy die verkopersvoorwaardes gelees het.
zu: Hlola isikhangiso sakho bese uthepha [[Save my listing]]
Ukulondoloza kumahhala. Akekho osibonayo okwamanje: usishicilela ku-app ngemva kokufunda imigomo yabathengisi.
xh: Jonga intengiso yakho uze ucofe [[Save my listing]]
Ukugcina kusimahla. Akukho mntu uyibonayo okwangoku: uyipapasha kwi-app emva kokufunda imigaqo yabathengisi.
nso: Lekola papatšo ya gago o kgotle [[Save my listing]]
Go boloka ke mahala. Ga go motho yo a e bonago ga bjale: o e phatlalatša go app ka morago ga go bala melawana ya barekiši.

en: Saved: now sign the terms and publish
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]]. It opens your advert in TrustSquare's Seller Hub.
af: Gestoor: teken nou die voorwaardes en publiseer
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Dit maak jou advertensie in TrustSquare se Seller Hub oop.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: manje sayina imigomo bese ushicilela
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Kuvula isikhangiso sakho ku-Seller Hub ye-TrustSquare.
xh: Igciniwe: ngoku tyikitya imigaqo uze upapashe
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]]. Ivula intengiso yakho kwi-Seller Hub ye-TrustSquare.
nso: E bolokilwe: bjale saena melawana o phatlalatše
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]]. E bula papatšo ya gago go Seller Hub ya TrustSquare.

en: Add your photos and the car's details
Tap [[Edit]], then [[Add Photo]]. Fill in model, year, mileage, colour, gearbox and fuel, and set [[For Sale]].
af: Voeg jou foto's en die motor se besonderhede by
Tik [[Edit]], dan [[Add Photo]]. Vul model, jaar, kilometers, kleur, ratkas en brandstof in, en kies [[For Sale]].
zu: Engeza izithombe zakho nemininingwane yemoto
Thepha [[Edit]], bese [[Add Photo]]. Gcwalisa imodeli, unyaka, amakhilomitha, umbala, igiya nophethiloli, bese ukhetha [[For Sale]].
xh: Faka iifoto zakho neenkcukacha zemoto
Cofa [[Edit]], emva koko [[Add Photo]]. Zalisa imodeli, unyaka, iikhilomitha, umbala, igiya nepetroli, uze ukhethe [[For Sale]].
nso: Tsenya diswantšho tša gago le dintlha tša koloi
Kgotla [[Edit]], ke moka [[Add Photo]]. Tlatša modele, ngwaga, dikhilomithara, mmala, giya le makhura, o kgethe [[For Sale]].

en: Accept the seller terms once
At your first [[Save Changes]] the seller terms open. Read to the end, tick both boxes and tap [[I accept]]. Your photo and details are kept.
af: Aanvaar die verkopersvoorwaardes een keer
By jou eerste [[Save Changes]] maak die verkopersvoorwaardes oop. Lees tot aan die einde, merk albei blokkies en tik [[I accept]]. Jou foto en besonderhede bly.
zu: Yamukela imigomo yabathengisi kanye
Ku-[[Save Changes]] yakho yokuqala kuvuleka imigomo yabathengisi. Funda kuze kube sekugcineni, khetha amabhokisi womabili bese uthepha [[I accept]]. Isithombe nemininingwane yakho kuyagcinwa.
xh: Yamkela imigaqo yabathengisi kube kanye
Kwi-[[Save Changes]] yakho yokuqala kuvuleka imigaqo yabathengisi. Funda ude uyigqibe, phawula zombini iibhokisi uze ucofe [[I accept]]. Ifoto neenkcukacha zakho ziyagcinwa.
nso: Amogela melawana ya barekiši gatee
Go [[Save Changes]] ya gago ya mathomo melawana ya barekiši e a bulega. Bala go fihla mafelelong, swaya mapokisi ka bobedi o kgotle [[I accept]]. Seswantšho le dintlha tša gago di a bolokwa.

en: Confirm the car's details
Tap [[Publish]]. Check each section against your papers, tap [[Confirm ✓]] on each and tick the box. Buyers only see details you confirmed.
af: Bevestig die motor se besonderhede
Tik [[Publish]]. Vergelyk elke afdeling met jou papiere, tik [[Confirm ✓]] by elkeen en merk die blokkie. Kopers sien net besonderhede wat jy bevestig het.
zu: Qinisekisa imininingwane yemoto
Thepha [[Publish]]. Qhathanisa isigaba ngasinye namaphepha akho, thepha [[Confirm ✓]] kuso ngasinye bese umaka ibhokisi. Abathengi babona kuphela imininingwane oyiqinisekisile.
xh: Qinisekisa iinkcukacha zemoto
Cofa [[Publish]]. Thelekisa icandelo ngalinye namaphepha akho, cofa [[Confirm ✓]] kwilinye nalinye uze uphawule ibhokisi. Abathengi babona kuphela iinkcukacha oziqinisekisileyo.
nso: Netefatša dintlha tša koloi
Kgotla [[Publish]]. Bapetša karolo ye nngwe le ye nngwe le dipampiri tša gago, kgotla [[Confirm ✓]] go ye nngwe le ye nngwe o swaye lepokisi. Bareki ba bona feela dintlha tšeo o di netefaditšego.

en: Tap [[Go live]]
Your advert is live and buyers can ask for an introduction. Until your ID is checked, buyers are told so: upload it in My Space to take that warning away.
af: Tik [[Go live]]
Jou advertensie is regstreeks en kopers kan vir 'n voorstelling vra. Totdat jou ID nagegaan is, word kopers dit meegedeel: laai dit in My Space op om daardie waarskuwing weg te neem.
zu: Thepha [[Go live]]
Isikhangiso sakho sesibukhoma futhi abathengi bangacela ukwethulwa. Kuze kuhlolwe i-ID yakho, abathengi bayatshelwa: yilayishe ku-My Space ukuze leso sexwayiso sisuke.
xh: Cofa [[Go live]]
Intengiso yakho iphilayo kwaye abathengi banokucela ukwaziswa. De kuhlolwe i-ID yakho, abathengi bayaxelelwa: yilayishe kwi-My Space ukuze eso silumkiso sisuswe.
nso: Kgotla [[Go live]]
Papatšo ya gago e phela gomme bareki ba ka kgopela go tsebišwa. Go fihlela ID ya gago e hlahlobja, bareki ba a botšwa: e tsenye go My Space go tloša temošo yeo.

en: A buyer opens Quick: [[Find a car]]
He swipes to Cars, taps [[Find a car]] and picks [[Bakkie]].
af: 'n Koper maak Quick oop: [[Find a car]]
Hy swiep na Cars, tik [[Find a car]] en kies [[Bakkie]].
zu: Umthengi uvula i-Quick: [[Find a car]]
Uswayipha aye ku-Cars, athephe [[Find a car]] bese ekhetha [[Bakkie]].
xh: Umthengi uvula i-Quick: [[Find a car]]
Utyibilikisa aye kwi-Cars, acofe [[Find a car]] aze akhethe [[Bakkie]].
nso: Moreki o bula Quick: [[Find a car]]
O šutiša go ya go Cars, a kgotla [[Find a car]] gomme a kgetha [[Bakkie]].

en: He picks his budget and area, and finds your bakkie
Real adverts come first; AI examples are marked. He taps yours.
af: Hy kies sy begroting en area, en kry jou bakkie
Regte advertensies kom eerste; KI-voorbeelde is gemerk. Hy tik op joune.
zu: Ukhetha isabelomali sakhe nendawo, bese ethola i-bakkie yakho
Izikhangiso zangempela ziza kuqala; izibonelo ze-AI ziphawuliwe. Uthepha esakho.
xh: Ukhetha uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwakhe nendawo, aze afumane ibhakkie yakho
Iintengiso zokwenyani zeza kuqala; imizekelo ye-AI iphawuliwe. Ucofa eyakho.
nso: O kgetha tekanyetšo ya gagwe le lefelo, gomme o hwetša bakkie ya gago
Dipapatšo tša nnete di tla pele; mehlala ya AI e swailwe. O kgotla ya gago.

en: He sees your price and the details you confirmed
Price, mileage, gearbox, fuel and the full spec sheet. Your name and number stay hidden.
af: Hy sien jou prys en die besonderhede wat jy bevestig het
Prys, kilometers, ratkas, brandstof en die volle spesifikasies. Jou naam en nommer bly versteek.
zu: Ubona intengo yakho nemininingwane oyiqinisekisile
Intengo, amakhilomitha, igiya, uphethiloli nemininingwane egcwele. Igama nenombolo yakho kuhlala kufihliwe.
xh: Ubona ixabiso lakho neenkcukacha oziqinisekisileyo
Ixabiso, iikhilomitha, igiya, ipetroli neenkcukacha ezipheleleyo. Igama nenombolo yakho zihlala zifihliwe.
nso: O bona theko ya gago le dintlha tšeo o di netefaditšego
Theko, dikhilomithara, giya, makhura le dintlha ka moka. Leina le nomoro ya gago di dula di utilwe.

en: Before he asks: the [[Car Purchase Dossier]]
Right on your advert he can order a dossier on this car: market price, known faults for its model and year, and a test-drive checklist.
af: Voordat hy vra: die [[Car Purchase Dossier]]
Reg op jou advertensie kan hy 'n dossier oor hierdie motor bestel: markprys, bekende foute vir die model en jaar, en 'n toetsrit-kontrolelys.
zu: Ngaphambi kokuthi acele: i-[[Car Purchase Dossier]]
Khona esikhangisweni sakho angaoda umbiko ngale moto: intengo yemakethe, amaphutha aziwayo emodeli nonyaka wayo, nohlu lokuhlola lokushayela.
xh: Phambi kokuba acele: i-[[Car Purchase Dossier]]
Kanye kwintengiso yakho angaodola ingxelo ngale moto: ixabiso lemarike, iziphene ezaziwayo zemodeli nonyaka wayo, noluhlu lokuhlola ukuqhuba.
nso: Pele a kgopela: [[Car Purchase Dossier]]
Gona papatšong ya gago a ka odara pego ka koloi ye: theko ya mmaraka, diphošo tše di tsebjago tša modele le ngwaga wa yona, le lenaneo la go leka go e otlela.

en: He gets the dossier: 3T
It is filled in with your car. He taps [[Get the report · 3T]]; in about two minutes it arrives, with the real adverts it was compared against. He pays only when it arrives.
af: Hy kry die dossier: 3T
Dit is reeds met jou motor ingevul. Hy tik [[Get the report · 3T]]; oor sowat twee minute kom dit, met die regte advertensies waarmee dit vergelyk is. Hy betaal net wanneer dit aankom.
zu: Uthola umbiko: 3T
Usuvele ugcwaliswe ngemoto yakho. Uthepha [[Get the report · 3T]]; cishe ngemizuzu emibili uyafika, nezikhangiso zangempela eqhathaniswe nazo. Ukhokha kuphela uma ufika.
xh: Ufumana ingxelo: 3T
Sele izaliswe ngemoto yakho. Ucofa [[Get the report · 3T]]; malunga nemizuzu emibini iyafika, neentengiso zokwenyani ethelekiswe nazo. Uhlawula kuphela xa ifikile.
nso: O hwetša pego: 3T
E šetše e tladitšwe ka koloi ya gago. O kgotla [[Get the report · 3T]]; ka metsotso e ka bago e mebedi e a fihla, le dipapatšo tša nnete tšeo e bapeditšwego le tšona. O lefa feela ge e fihla.

en: The 1T fair-price check
A separate 1T check appears on car adverts once eight similar cars are listed on TrustSquare. Until then the dossier gives the market price.
af: Die 1T-billike-prys-toets
'n Aparte 1T-toets verskyn op motoradvertensies sodra agt soortgelyke motors op TrustSquare gelys is. Tot dan gee die dossier die markprys.
zu: Ukuhlolwa kwentengo efanele okungu-1T
Ukuhlola okuhlukile okungu-1T kuvela ezikhangisweni zezimoto uma sekunezimoto eziyisishiyagalombili ezifanayo ku-TrustSquare. Kuze kube yilapho, umbiko unikeza intengo yemakethe.
xh: Uhlolo lwexabiso elifanelekileyo olu-1T
Uhlolo olwahlukileyo olu-1T luvela kwiintengiso zeemoto xa kukho iimoto ezisibhozo ezifanayo kwi-TrustSquare. Ukuza kuthi ga ngoko, ingxelo inika ixabiso lemarike.
nso: Tekolo ya theko ye e lokilego ya 1T
Tekolo ye e aroganego ya 1T e tšwelela dipapatšong tša dikoloi ge go na le dikoloi tše seswai tše di swanago go TrustSquare. Go fihlela ka nako yeo, pego e fa theko ya mmaraka.

en: He asks for an introduction
He taps [[Join queue]], adds a message and sends. 1T is held from him and only spent if you accept.
af: Hy vra vir 'n voorstelling
Hy tik [[Join queue]], voeg 'n boodskap by en stuur. 1T word van hom teruggehou en net gebruik as jy aanvaar.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Uthepha [[Join queue]], engeze umlayezo bese ethumela. U-1T uyabanjwa kuye futhi usetshenziswa kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ucofa [[Join queue]], ongeze umyalezo aze athumele. I-1T iyabanjwa kuye kwaye isetyenziswa kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O kgotla [[Join queue]], a oketša molaetša gomme a romela. 1T e swarwa go yena gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: You see his request
In the Seller Hub your advert shows [[1 request waiting]] with his first name and message.
af: Jy sien sy versoek
In die Seller Hub wys jou advertensie [[1 request waiting]] met sy voornaam en boodskap.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Ku-Seller Hub isikhangiso sakho sibonisa [[1 request waiting]] negama lakhe lokuqala nomlayezo wakhe.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Kwi-Seller Hub intengiso yakho ibonisa [[1 request waiting]] negama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo wakhe.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe
Go Seller Hub papatšo ya gago e bontšha [[1 request waiting]] le leina la gagwe la pele le molaetša.

en: Tap [[Accept]]
You pay nothing: his 1T is spent now. You both get an email; reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Tik [[Accept]]
Jy betaal niks: sy 1T word nou gebruik. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos; antwoord dit om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Thepha [[Accept]]
Awukhokhi lutho: u-1T wakhe usetshenziswa manje. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili; yiphendule ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Cofa [[Accept]]
Awuhlawuli nto: i-1T yakhe isetyenziswa ngoku. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile; yiphendule ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Kgotla [[Accept]]
Ga o lefe selo: 1T ya gagwe e šomišwa bjale. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile; e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: He sees it accepted
In My Space, under Intros, his request shows [[Accepted]]. The rest is between the two of you, by email.
af: Hy sien dit is aanvaar
In My Space, onder Intros, wys sy versoek [[Accepted]]. Die res is tussen julle twee, per e-pos.
zu: Ubona ukuthi samukelwe
Ku-My Space, ngaphansi kwe-Intros, isicelo sakhe sibonisa [[Accepted]]. Okunye kuphakathi kwenu nobabili, nge-imeyili.
xh: Ubona ukuba samkelwe
Kwi-My Space, phantsi kwe-Intros, isicelo sakhe sibonisa [[Accepted]]. Okunye kuphakathi kwenu nobabini, nge-imeyile.
nso: O bona gore e amogetšwe
Go My Space, ka fase ga Intros, kgopelo ya gagwe e bontšha [[Accepted]]. Tše dingwe ke magareng ga lena ka bobedi, ka imeile.

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who has something to sell.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriend wat iets het om te verkoop.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane onento yokuthengisa.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo onento yokuthengisa.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] o e abelane le mogwera yo a nago le se sengwe sa go rekiša.
